description: This Python script demonstrates using the Perplexity API as a drop-in replacement for OpenAI, implementing a chat bot with speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and language model services, integrated into a pipeline with event handlers for client connection management.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Represents the context for the language model, including message history.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Pairs the LLM context with user and assistant aggregators for managing conversation state.

classes.name: LLMUserAggregatorParams
classes.description: Parameters configuring user message aggregation and turn strategies.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines the sequence of processing steps for the bot's operation.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline with its parameters and execution settings.

classes.name: PipelineParams
classes.description: Configuration options for a pipeline, such as metrics and timeouts.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Manages the execution of a pipeline, including handling signals and running tasks.

classes.name: LLMRunFrame
classes.description: Represents a frame for running the language model within the pipeline.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Sets up and runs the bot pipeline with specified transport and runner arguments.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, initializes transport and starts the bot process.
